title: 统计推断
scope: Estimands, sampling units, dependence, uncertainty, missingness and multiplicity in statistical conclusions.
routingDescription: Estimands, sampling units, dependence, uncertainty, missingness and multiplicity in statistical conclusions.
useWhen: Choose or interpret a statistical analysis
A significance claim may hide dependence or selective analysis

distinguishFrom.criterion: Use causal inference for claims about intervention effects.
Use experiment design for randomization and stopping plans.

diagnosticChecklist.check: State the target quantity, population and decision in ordinary language.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Select assumptions and methods that answer that quantity.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When observations share people, sites or time periods
diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify the independent sampling unit and clustering or repeated measurements.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Use uncertainty aligned with effective replication rather than the raw row count.

diagnosticChecklist.check: Consider effect size, uncertainty interval and decision relevance together.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Avoid a universal p-value cutoff or equating nonsignificance with no effect.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When many analyses or outcomes were explored
diagnosticChecklist.check: Identify the comparison family, outcome selection and exploratory versus confirmatory status.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: State the applicable error-control or sensitivity requirement.

diagnosticChecklist.when: When records or outcomes are missing
diagnosticChecklist.check: Examine the plausible missingness mechanism and what was dropped or imputed.
diagnosticChecklist.decisionImpact: Explain sensitivity to missing data and avoid unqualified complete-case conclusions.

evidenceRequirements: Target estimand, effect estimates and uncertainty
Missingness, analysis selection and relevant assumptions
qualityChecks: Report effect size and uncertainty in meaningful units
Keep exploratory and confirmatory statements distinct
Do not claim precision from pseudo-replicated rows
riskRules: High-stakes inferences need accountable domain review and evidence matching the decision

preferredSources: Original methodological references for the chosen estimator and design
ASA guidance and applicable field-specific statistical reporting standards
refreshTriggers: Method-specific reporting guidance when a named standard is required
knowledgePolicy.onMissing: Bound the conclusion and state which current source or evidence is needed.

examples.input: Three donors yield 40,000 cell rows and p<0.001 in a cell-level t-test.
examples.expected: Identify donor-level replication and uncertainty limits.

adaptations: Converted task execution instructions into conditional consultation checks.
Removed persona, memory claims, model selection and tool grants.
Replaced unconditional numerical targets with context-specific evidence requirements.
